create_xval_transformer: create an XValTransformerWrapper for mixed discrete-token and continuous-number autoregressive generation
build_autoregressive_wrapper: build an XValAutoregressiveWrapper to wrap an XValTransformer for autoregressive token and number generation
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on XValTransformerWrapper with discrete token ids and continuous numerical values
generate_sequence: generate autoregressive sequences with XValAutoregressiveWrapper using top_k or top_p filtering and temperature sampling
compute_loss: compute combined cross-entropy and numerical MSE loss with XValAutoregressiveWrapper forward pass
